changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'UnresolvedRelationships') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[UnresolvedRelationships]( [ID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationUnresolvedRelationships_ID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [FieldName] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [IntersectTypeID] [int] NULL, [SourceID] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [SubjectAssetTypeID] [int] NULL, [SubjectSourceID] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [SubjectAssetID] [bigint] NULL, [Subject] [varchar](50) NULL, [SubjectID] [int] NULL, [ObjectAssetTypeID] [int] NULL, [ObjectSourceID] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [ObjectAssetID] [bigint] NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [Action] [char](1) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationUnresolvedRelationships] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
